tour.welcomeBody: Your books live here now. Here's a 30-second look around — or skip and explore on your own.
tour.sidebarBody: Sales, expenses, banking, reports, and payroll all live in the sidebar. Your plan unlocks more sections as you grow.
tour.actionsBody: The + button records a transaction, invoice, or client from any page. Prefer the keyboard? Ctrl+K searches pages and records.
tour.bellBody: Paid invoices, completed reconciliations, and team changes show up here — and by email, which you can tune in My Account.
tour.checklistBody: The getting-started checklist walks you through your first account, transaction, and invoice. Knock them out one by one!

ivu.title: IVU mensual
ivu.subtitle: Monthly sales & use tax (SC 2915) prep — state 10.5% / municipal 1% split from your invoices.
ivu.disclaimer: Prep figures for the SC 2915 you file in SURI by the 20th of the following month — not a filed return. Since Aug 2026 the 1% municipal IVU is also filed through SURI for most municipalities (Bayamón, Carolina, Guaynabo, Mayagüez and San Juan keep separate filing). Figures are accrual-basis from sent invoices.
